extractive_spans: The KNN classifier seem to perform the best across all four metrics. This is probably due to the multi-class nature of the data set
While these classifiers did not perform particularly well, they provide a good starting point for future work on this subject
evidence: In order to evaluate our classifiers, we perform 4-fold cross validation on a shuffled data set. Table TABREF10 shows the F1 micro and F1 macro scores for all the classifiers. The KNN classifier seem to perform the best across all four metrics. This is probably due to the multi-class nature of the data set.

answer.free_form_answer: Using F1 Micro measure, the KNN classifier perform 0.6762, the RF 0.6687, SVM 0.6712 and MLP 0.6778.

title: Understanding Car-Speak: Replacing Humans in Dealerships
answer_rationale: The KNN classifier is identified as the top performer based on 4-fold cross-validation results reported in Table TABREF10, which includes F1 micro and macro scores for all classifiers.
